steps.text: The options! Everything is in tabs on this panel.
The tabs: Q/E (or TAB) change them, or click them.
UP/DOWN pick an option, LEFT/RIGHT change it (hold them to go faster) and ENTER turns it on or off. R puts it back the way it was at first.
What the option does is written here.
"More" has the colors of the notes, the controls, the delay and combo, and the language. ESC goes back.
